annotations.title: Multi-CMS SEO/GEO Autopilot & GSC Decay Sync

description: Synchronize Google Search Console rank decay alerts (`action: 'sync_gsc_decay'`, read-only), stage Answer-First CMS rewrites (`action: 'stage_cms_rewrite'`, requires `target_url` and `target_keyword`, non-destructive draft), publish approved changes live (`action: 'publish_staged_change'`, requires `change_id` and `cms_platform`, mutates live CMS unless `night_routine=true` holds it in review), or revert a deployment (`action: 'rollback_change'`, requires `change_id`). Requires a valid Argosor Bearer API key and a connected BYOK CMS or GSC credential in the workspace vault. Returns `{ alerts, stagedDiff, changeId, actionBoard, rollbackReady }` sorted by expected click gain.

action.description: Autopilot operation to execute: "sync_gsc_decay" (read-only GSC decay check), "stage_cms_rewrite" (non-destructive draft requiring target_url and target_keyword), "publish_staged_change" (mutates live CMS requiring change_id and cms_platform), or "rollback_change" (reverts a deployment requiring change_id).

change_id.description: Staged change identifier returned by a prior "stage_cms_rewrite" call; required when action is "publish_staged_change" or "rollback_change".

cms_platform.description: Target CMS or Git deployment adapter used when action is "stage_cms_rewrite", "publish_staged_change", or "rollback_change" (default: "github_pr_nextjs_astro").

domain.description: Target project root domain managed by the SEO and GEO Autopilot (e.g., "argosor.com").

night_routine.description: Human-in-the-loop safety guardrail used by "stage_cms_rewrite" and "publish_staged_change": when true, holds changes in review status without mutating the live CMS (default: true).

target_keyword.description: Primary keyword or buyer prompt targeted by the staged page rewrite; required when action is "stage_cms_rewrite" and optional filter for "sync_gsc_decay".

target_url.description: Target page URL to stage an Answer-First SEO and GEO rewrite for; required when action is "stage_cms_rewrite".

name: cms_autopilot_sync
